dex.entry: A small leonine cub whose coat has mineralised into gilded stone plates, soaking up ambient Solar energy from the Solarium's ruins. It naps in sun-warmed arches and radiates stored heat. A golden armoured cub — solid, warm, and endearing, like a sun-kissed statue that decided to yawn.

art.silhouette: Compact lion-cub silhouette; body covered in smooth gold-toned stone plates like overlapping scales; four stubby paws with amber glowing pawpads; round face with bright amber eyes; cute and sturdy at 32px.
